provenance: Majority vote of Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4 mini, and Opus 5 over 521 columns (no ties). One case has two votes for Sonnet and one for Opus because they exceeded the 90 s profiling timeout.
rules: Named ordered levels (Poor to Rich, small to large) are ordinal even without digits.
Place names, airports, and coordinates are geography; the widened deterministic hint overrides a majority category label.
An integer year column is ordinal: ordered periods, not a quantity to sum and not a date.
Age bands such as 20-25 and 51+ are ordinal even when an 'other' bucket sits beside them.
Education levels (intermediate diploma to doctorate) are named ordered levels, so ordinal.
